premises.text: Cross-border remittances suffer lost funds, delays, high cost, and low transparency
premises.evidence_span: Lost funds, delayed delivery of funds, high cost, low transparency

premises.text: SendMe integrates with employer payroll so employees can send payroll funds cross-border, top up phones, and pay international bills
premises.evidence_span: SendMe is a global flex pay solution that integrates with an employer's payroll system and allows employees to send payroll funds cross-border, top up mobile phones, and pay international bills

premises.text: FDIC-insured employer-linked wallet receives a portion of each paycheck for abroad transfers at as little as $1
premises.evidence_span: that balance is held at a financial institution and is FDIC-insured, which puts employers at ease

premises.text: Direct central-bank connections (e.g., Mexico) enable instant bank transfers and create interoperability across banking networks
premises.evidence_span: We have built a direct connection to the Central Bank of Mexico, which allows us to do an instant transfer to Mexican bank accounts

premises.text: Recipients can also retrieve funds via a large ATM network with a code
premises.evidence_span: We can also send funds to a network of over 10,000 BBVA ATMs in Mexico

premises.text: Combining payroll with money-service business shifts payer to employers, cuts regulatory and CAC costs, and distributes via banks, payroll providers, and employers
premises.evidence_span: We combine payroll with money service business, and in so doing, shift user behavior, reduce regulatory costs, and reduce customer acquisition costs

value.text: High-transparency, lower-cost, more efficient international money transfers
value.evidence_span: What we've created is a solution that is high transparency, lower cost

secondary_value.text: Drive the cost of international transfer toward zero via value-added services
secondary_value.evidence_span: we're driving the cost of the international transfer to zero

causal_links.evidence_span: We've experienced every problem imaginable as it relates to sending money
allows employees to send payroll funds cross-border
We distribute the products to banks, payroll providers, and direct to employers

notes: Remittance pain list folded into P1. Cross-border bill pay/phone top-up treated as part of flex-pay product surface in P2 rather than separate premises. Pricing amount kept with wallet/commercial claim in P3. Team bios and active partnership conversations excluded as credentials/traction.
